entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: The plane of New Capenna, devastated by Phyrexian invaders and largely uninhabited outside the city.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The metropolis built by angels on girders above Old Capenna's capital, ruled by five crime families.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who devastated Capenna in two invasions.

entities.name: Archangels of Capenna
entities.description: Divine warriors who defended Capenna and were later trapped by the archdemons.

entities.name: Archdemons of Capenna
entities.description: Demons who allied with the archangels and then betrayed them, converting angels into Halo.

entities.name: The five families
entities.description: The five crime families, Maestros, Riveteers, Cabaretti, Obscura and Brokers, that rule New Capenna's three boroughs by a mutually agreed code.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: The fuel made from the stasis-trapped bodies of angels, used as a weapon against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who grew up in a Phyrexian holdout camp and arrives in New Capenna seeking her home plane.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who told Elspeth where to planeswalk to find her home.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who claims the plane outside the city is essentially dead.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A deity worshiped on Capenna.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who infiltrated New Capenna and struck the family leaders during the Crescendo.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: A crime boss killed in Ob Nixilis's strike.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: A crime boss mortally wounded in Ob Nixilis's strike.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: Possibly the last free angel, whose sacrifice begins the angels' reawakening.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor sent by Elesh Norn to lead the Machine Legion against Capenna.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler who sends Atraxa to Capenna.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whose death on Dominaria likely caused the Phyrexian slumber on Capenna.

entities.name: Adversary War
entities.description: The conflict in which Ob Nixilis struck New Capenna's families.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The second Phyrexian invasion of Capenna.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: A New Capenna structure collapsed onto Atraxa.

events.summary: A single Phyrexian ship invades Capenna, eating hope and poisoning the plane, and nearly succeeds before the archangels' intervention.
events.quote: a single Phyrexian ship invaded Capenna

events.summary: The archangels see they cannot win as the Phyrexians raise the mortal dead against their comrades.
events.quote: it was plain to the archangels that they could not win

events.summary: The archangels strike a deal with the archdemons, founding New Capenna as a fortress city.
events.quote: the archangels turned to an old, familiar enemy: the archdemons

events.summary: Refugees stream into the city and the last elevator arrives; New Capenna is sealed to all below.
events.quote: the last elevator arrived, and New Capenna was sealed to all below

events.summary: The archdemons plot to trap the angels and spread their essence across New Capenna to drive the enemy back.
events.quote: trap the angels, and let an age of demons begin

events.summary: The archdemons appoint five families, trap the archangels during a victory celebration and convert them into Halo, then vanish.
events.quote: The Demon Lords used the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

events.summary: The five families dominate the city under an agreed code rather than law.
events.quote: Instead, there is an agreement, a code agreed to by the five families.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo, killing Xander and mortally wounding Jetmir; Giada's sacrifice awakens the angels.
events.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir mortally wounded.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Elesh Norn sends Atraxa to lead the Machine Legion against Capenna.
events.quote: Atraxa herself was sent by Elesh Norn to lead the efforts of the Machine Legion against the Capennans.

events.summary: The gangs collapse Park Heights onto Atraxa, killing her, and the reviving angels go through the omenpaths to attack New Phyrexia.
events.quote: The gangs formulated a plan to collapse the structure holding Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her.

events.summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna on Ajani's directions, feeling out of place.
events.quote: Arriving in New Capenna, she felt out of place as the plane was nothing like she imagined it.

relations.quote: the archdemons sent their whisperers to the ears of mortal, power-hungry Capennans

relations.note: appointed them to rule the city
relations.quote: The archdemons appointed five families to rule the city in their name

relations.note: sent by her to lead the Machine Legion
relations.quote: Atraxa herself was sent by Elesh Norn
hosting a targeted strike on their leadership on the night of the Crescendo

relations.note: told her where to find her home plane
relations.quote: Ajani Goldmane , who told her where to planeswalk to find her home plane
Capenna is the plane on which the metropolis of New Capenna is located.
